title: human.idea_provided (v1)
description: The human's response at the HumanIdeaCheckpoint state (state machine V1.10 §1): either a plain confirmation (inject=false) or an injected idea seed (inject=true, human_idea_seed_ref pointing at the stored HumanIdeaSeed). Emitted with envelope.emitter == 'Human'.

inject.description: Whether the human is injecting an idea seed (true) or simply confirming to proceed (false).

human_idea_seed_ref.description: Opaque ref into the Research Store resolving to the injected HumanIdeaSeed object. Present only when inject is true.
